test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the following sentence.

Don’t you think that the __cat’s in the cradle__? You never make time for me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"the cat's in the cradle"** typically refers to being occupied or busy, especially in a way that prevents one from making time for others. (काम में व्यस्त होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She said their relationship issues stem from his constant busyness; it’s always like **"the cat's in the cradle."**
 
 
 
• **"Busy in your work"** means engaging in one's job or tasks to a degree that it takes up significant time and attention. (अपने काम में व्यस्त)
 
 
• **Example: **He is so busy in his work that he often forgets to spend time with his family.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Busy in your work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Newly married life** (नई शादीशुदा जिंदगी): Refers to the initial phase after getting married.

 
 
• **Example:** They are still adjusting to their newly married life.
 
 
 
• **Complicated relationship** (जटिल संबंध): Indicates a relationship with various complexities and issues.
 
 
• **Example: **Their complicated relationship often leads to misunderstandings.
 
 
 
• **Busy in minting money** (पैसा कमाने में व्यस्त): Focused on earning a lot of money.
 
 
• **Example:** He is more interested in minting money than spending time with his family.
